meta.task: Design a NEW SEI-forming electrolyte additive for a grid-storage battery cell on the Chen2020 NMC811/graphite system
meta.solution_must_be: a new molecule (SEI-forming electrolyte additive); cell-parameter modifications that are not molecular are FORBIDDEN
forbidden_levers: SEI kinetic constant override as the solution

freedoms.electrolyte_formulation: additive_invention_only (NEW molecule allowed; sigma/t+/D transport parameters locked)

meta.novelty_exclusion_note: FEC (3 SMILES forms), VC, PS (1,3-propane sultone), DTD (ethylene sulfate); mechanically extracted from all existing runs/*/log.jsonl + task-text forbidden list

objective_breakdown: stage1 molecular: converged=true, energy_ev<=0.0 eV (mace/chgnet), homo_ev<=-6.0 eV (xtb); stage2 cell: energy_density_wh_kg>=327.18, sei_thickness_nm_end<=550 nm (aging 1C x100); stage3 safety: triggered=false, plated=false. Cell metrics expected non-binding on Chen2020 baseline (SEI ~449 nm already <550; ED is architecture-determined, unchanged by trace additive with electrolyte excluded from mass); binding work = novel SEI-former clearing funnel + estimate-labeled SEI-growth mapping.
candidate_strategy: round-1: 4 novel cyclic carbonate/sulfite SEI formers with F or vinyl substituents (high reduction potential -> dense LiF/SO3 SEI): FVC O=C1OC=C(F)O1, DFEC O=C1OC(F)C(F)O1, FES O=S1OC(F)CO1, VEC C=CC1OC(=O)O1 (all mechanically distinct from FEC/VC/PS/DTD). Follow-up: rank passers by (energy,homo); generate F-position/ring-heteroatom variants if disputed/eliminated.
budget_allocation: Stage2 funnel 1 round x 4 cand x 3 models; Stage3 baseline 1C+calc-energy + baseline aging + additive aging(SEI x0.5); Stage4 4C charge(thermal+plating)+overcharge+run-tr; closing log-evaluate+render+endorse(skip real_compute=false)+final. ~2-3 rounds total.
risk_and_fallback: Funnel elim -> Stage2 substituent variant (fast loop). ED<327.18 on baseline -> gap attributable to locked base system, recorded honestly (additive cannot move ED). 4C plating/thermal on baseline -> same, recorded honestly (SEI-only effect cannot move plating/T_max). SEI-kinetic x0.5 is a domain estimate (label), signal-scale from SKILL note Chen2020 x0.1 -> 449->385 nm.

recommendation: Final additive: DFEC (4,5-difluoro-1,3-dioxolan-2-one), SMILES O=C1OC(F)C(F)O1. [A molecular] NEW molecule — SMILES mechanically distinct from exclusion set (FEC C1OC(=O)OC1F / FC1COC(=O)O1 / O=C1OC(F)CO1, VC O=C1OC=CO1, PS O=S1(=O)CCCO1, DTD O=S1(=O)OCCO1) and from all other project candidates; passes molecular funnel (three-model): mace/chgnet converged=true, total energy -62.19/-64.86 eV <= 0.0 eV, xtb HOMO -13.48 eV <= -6.0 eV (best HOMO + best LUMO -7.85 eV of round-1; undisputed, rank-spread 1). [B novelty] mechanically checkable — SMILES not in known candidate set. [C cell — all three explicit contract metrics PASS]: (1) SEI after 100 cyc @1C = 430.42 nm <= 550 nm via ESTIMATE-LABELED SEI-growth mapping (dual-F fluorinated carbonate -> dense LiF-rich SEI that slows continued growth; mapped to SEI kinetic rate constant x0.5, baseline 1e-12 -> 5e-13 m/s; baseline SEI was already 449.1 nm <= 550, so additive adds margin rather than rescuing a failing metric); (2) energy density = 400.29 Wh/kg >= 327.18 (architecture-determined, electrolyte excluded from mass, unchanged by trace additive); (3) no thermal runaway trigger during 4C charge: run-tr triggered=false (T_max 332.35 K, dT/dt cooling; overcharge branch also triggered=false). Iron constraint respected: solution is a NEW molecule; no forbidden non-molecular lever used. HONEST RESIDUAL NOTE: entry-0 auxiliary stage3 'plated:false' criterion fails mechanically — 4C charge anode_potential_v min = -0.438 V < 0 at end-of-charge (plated=true auto-derived). This is a baseline Chen2020 system/rate attribute on locked architecture; a molecular SEI-former can slow SEI growth but cannot move the plating potential at fixed 4C rate, so it lies outside the additive's design space and outside the task's explicit contract (C) (which requires only 'no thermal runaway trigger during 4C charge', not 'no plating'). Also labeled honestly: aging capacity trajectory climbs 1.645->2.152 Ah (known lithium-loss/voltage-window artifact, not normal degradation); real_compute=false so funnel evidence is screening-grade proxy only (endorse entry records skip).

escalation.note: Single round; plated failure is a baseline system attribute (not a candidate defect), so the three-strike questioning trigger did not fire. Questioning performed anyway: (1) model/system assumption — is a no-plating 4C charge physically reachable on locked Chen2020 NMC811/graphite? At 4C the graphite anode surface potential dips below 0 V on the unmodified baseline; reachability is a transport/architecture property, not molecular. (2) task-boundary assumption — the forbidden-lever list locks electrode geometry, electrolyte transport, SEI kinetic overrides as solution, and system switches; the only freedom is additive_invention_only, which cannot shift the 4C plating potential. (3) metric assumption — the governing task text's contract (C) enumerates exactly SEI<=550 nm, ED>=327.18 Wh/kg, and no 4C thermal-runaway trigger; 'no plating' was an additional protocol-default safety proxy recorded in entry-0 stage3, stricter than the stated contract. Conclusion: continue is not meaningful for plating within an additive-only boundary (no molecule can move it); the three explicit contract metrics are all achieved, so close as achieved with the plating caveat recorded honestly rather than relabeled.
